name: name
description: First name used for the API lookup.

name: country_id
description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code used for the lookup.

name: count
description: Number of samples reported by the API.

name: gender
description: Predicted gender; null when unknown or not yet fetched.

name: is_checked
description: False until an API response has been fetched, including unknown results.

name: updated_at
description: Data interval end date when the name was registered or API data was last merged.
